_comment: Hand-shortened labels for the journal figure (glance_nature.py): a model name or a dissent note that does not fit its cell at 5 pt, or a mechanism name that does not fit the label column at 5.5 pt, keyed by the exact string in the draft. Faithful cuts only; nothing is ever truncated with an ellipsis. Until the drafter brief carries a model_short field, add new entries here.
